messages:
alex: Anyone else seeing p95 spike for qwen2.5 hosted yesterday? Started ~02:10 UTC.
marta: yep, saw 12% drop in throughput on dedicated pool 3. I profiled a few traces.
alex: Profile looks like kernel autoselector falling back to generic CUDA kernel for many batches. Suspect tokenizer produced extra tokens due to multichar CJK segmentation -> ropescale mismatch?
hao: Do you have a trace? Also KV cache indexing mismatch can force k-v dim coercion which triggers fallback.
alex: trace snippet: ```kernel_selector: fallback -> generic_cuda
reason: kv_layout_mismatch
batch_len: [1,64,1,1]
latency(ms): 12.3 -> 48.7```
samir: uuh, kv_layout_mismatch. We recently changed kv_head_dim inference for qwen2.5 in model metadata. Could be wrong for some quantized variants.
lexi: I repro locally with a multi-ling prompt: English + Chinese + Thai. Tokenizer split makes extra subwords -> longer prefix -> ropescale interpolation picks different scale -> kv index shift?
marta: Got a perf profile: ```top functions:
1. kernel_dispatcher (45%)
2. kv_read_coerce (17%)
3. tokenizer_postsplit (12%)
4. batch_padder (8%)```
hao: Quick hypothesis: the batching heuristic merges sequences by token_count, but our batcher assumes consistent kv_stride per head. If tokenizer produces surges in short tokens, we hit mismatch and run re-layout.
alex: I pushed a quick instrumented build that logs `kv_layout` per request. Results show ~3% of requests had kv_layout_shape: (heads, kv_head_dim) mismatching model spec.
samir: Possible root: upstream tokenizer update that changed tokenization for codepoints > U+0800. Which version are hosts running?
lexi: we had a silent tokenizer bump on 2026-03-05 (v2.14.1) in some edge pools. Should be rolled back if it's the cause. But we should also avoid falling back to generic kernel for small mismatches.
marta: Proposed short fixes: (1) add tolerant kv_layout caster that accepts minor dim differences and pads on-the-fly; (2) adjust kernel_selector to prefer optimized kernel if only kv_head_dim differs by <=2; (3) add unit test with mixed-language prompts.
hao: Will prototype patch for (2) and (1). Also add a guard to batcher to avoid coalescing if tokenizer variance > threshold.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: runtime-autokernel-kv-tolerant (sha: a1b2c3) -> eng-runtime-canary-4 at 2079989000
alex: :thumbsup: test plan: synthetic fuzz with CJK + Thai + Arabic, run 1000 reqs, assert kernel_selector fallback rate < 0.5% and p95 latency delta < 5%.
samir: Also add a metric `kv_layout_mismatch{model, pool}` to alert at 0.5% over 5m.
marta: I'll coordinate rollback of tokenizer bump in the pools that show spikes. Running a quick diff on token counts per prompt.
lexi: Thanks. I'll add regression test to the model onboarding suite to catch tokenizer/version mismatch vs kv_head_dim.
alex: Good. Keep updates here. If we still see fallback after patch, we'll bisect kernel heuristics.
